title: Reusable silicone cupcake cups
text: Reusable silicone cupcake cups. Reusable silicone cupcake cups... there are 6 red 6 gray - about the size of regular cupcake papers - maybe a tiny bit larger. The cups are pretty sturdy- but you should put into a tin in my opinion. The package they came in was completely destroyed. If I were in a store I would not have purchased with destroyed packaging- it should not have been sent out that way. They are silicone so dishwasher safe. However they are light so I put them in the top rack with a couple of bowls over top to keep them in place.

product_metadata.title: Mirenlife 12 Pack Reusable Nonstick Jumbo Silicone Baking Cups, Cupcake and Muffin Liners, 3.8 Inch Large Size, Red and Gray Colors, Round
